title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Implementation of the National Strategy of Actively Responding to Population Aging
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Implementing the National Strategy to Actively Respond to Population Aging

Fa Fa [2022] No. 15

To comprehensively implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Strengthening Work on Aging in the New Era," deeply implement the national strategy to actively respond to population aging, fully leverage the role of trial functions, and effectively enhance the sense of gain, happiness, and security of the elderly, the following opinions are hereby put forward in light of actual work regarding the people's courts providing services and safeguards for the implementation of the national strategy to actively respond to population aging.

I. Unify Ideological Understanding and Accurately Grasp the Overall Requirements for Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Implementing the National Strategy to Actively Respond to Population Aging

1. Guiding Ideology. People's courts at all levels shall effectively enhance their political stance, adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, deeply study and comprehend the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." Adhere to a people-centered approach, integrate the philosophy of active aging and healthy aging into the entire process of trial and enforcement work, vigorously promote the traditional Chinese virtues of filial piety and respect for the elderly, and provide strong judicial services and safeguards for building an age-friendly society and strengthening the protection of the rights and interests of the elderly.

2. Significant Significance. Population aging is a basic national condition of our country for a considerable period in the future. As the degree of aging deepens and the number of labor supply decreases, the burden of family support for the elderly and the pressure of basic public service supply will further increase. Effectively responding to the aging of our population concerns the overall national development, the well-being of hundreds of millions of people, and social harmony and stability, and is of great significance for comprehensively building a modern socialist country. People's courts at all levels shall fully recognize the importance and urgency of implementing the national strategy to actively respond to population aging, take effective measures to effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of the elderly, and enable the elderly to share the fruits of reform and development and enjoy a happy old age.

3. Objectives and Tasks. In the new stage of development, people's courts at all levels shall establish and improve a work system that is coherent from top to bottom and implements tasks to the end, incorporating services and safeguards for implementing the national strategy to actively respond to population aging into the overall work of trial and enforcement. Promote the improvement of preferential policies and regulatory systems for the elderly. The formulation and implementation of judicial policies involving the interests of the elderly shall fully solicit the opinions of the elderly, and promote the implementation, grounding, and detailing of various policy measures of the people's courts in serving and safeguarding the implementation of the national strategy to actively respond to population aging.

II. Fully Leverage the Role of Trial Functions and Strengthen the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly

4. Lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes over marriage and family involving the elderly. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over maintenance obligations to ensure the basic living needs of the elderly. Strengthen mediation efforts in cases concerning spiritual support for the elderly to enhance emotional care for the elderly. Emphasize the court's ex officio investigation, strengthen adjudication according to law, and lawfully protect the marriage freedom of the elderly. For disputes over property division after cohabitation involving the elderly, comprehensively consider factors such as the duration of cohabitation and respective contributions, balance the interests of both parties, and achieve fairness and justice.

5. Lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes over inheritance involving the elderly. Implement the estate administrator system under the Civil Code, lawfully determine estate administrators, and ensure the proper management and smooth division of the estate. Lawfully protect various forms of wills, effectively respect the true intentions of the elderly when making wills, and protect the right of the elderly to dispose of their estate. Lawfully recognize the validity of various legacy-support agreements to meet the diversified needs of elderly care forms.

6. Implement the Anti-Domestic Violence Law to protect the personal and property safety of elderly family members. Promote the establishment of a macro system against domestic violence with the participation of various departments. Strengthen guidance on evidence collection for elderly victims of domestic violence, and increase psychological counseling and assistance efforts. Establish a "green channel" for accepting applications for personal safety protection orders, increase efforts to collect evidence ex officio, and lawfully and promptly issue and serve personal safety protection orders. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with public security organs, residents' committees, villagers' committees, and other departments, fully utilize the system of assistance in enforcement, and ensure that personal safety protection orders effectively play their role. Establish a system of regular return visits and follow-up, and expand the scope of extended services for anti-domestic violence.

7. Improve the guardianship system for the elderly. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over guardianship rights, respecting the true intentions of the elderly parties to the greatest extent. Lawfully recognize guardians designated by the elderly through voluntary guardianship agreements, and supervise the guardians' performance of their guardianship duties according to law. For guardians who infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of elderly persons with no or limited capacity for civil conduct, revoke their guardianship qualifications according to law, arrange necessary temporary guardianship measures for the elderly, and designate a guardian according to law in a manner most beneficial to the ward, protecting the personal rights, property rights, and other legitimate rights and interests of the elderly.

8. Lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes related to elderly care to promote care for the elderly in old age. Implement the provisions of the Civil Code on the right of habitation, lawfully adjudicate cases involving the protection of the right of habitation of the elderly, meet the stable living and housing needs of the elderly, and provide solid legal guarantees for the "housing for elderly care" model. Lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes over elderly care service contracts, ensuring that elderly care institutions provide elderly care services that meet quality and safety standards, and promote the standardized development of institutional elderly care.

9. Promote the development of rural elderly care security services. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving the right to contracted management of rural land, infringement on the rights and interests of members of collective economic organizations, etc., to ensure that the elderly lawfully enjoy the rights and interests of members of their collective economic organizations, and increase the income of the elderly in rural areas. Leverage the role of trial functions to ensure that elderly villagers without labor capacity, without a source of income, and without support or maintenance enjoy the "five guarantees" support treatment in rural areas.

10. Lawfully and properly adjudicate disputes over medical service contracts involving the elderly to promote medical care for the elderly in old age. Lawfully determine the rights and obligations of the parties in home medical service contracts such as home hospital beds and itinerant medical services, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of the elderly. Properly adjudicate disputes over medical service contracts for the elderly and long-term care service contracts for disabled elderly persons, leverage trial functions to ensure the implementation of the policy of combining medical care and elderly care, and safeguard the healthy life of the elderly.

11. Strengthen the protection of labor rights and interests of the elderly to promote their productive participation. Lawfully adjudicate labor disputes involving the elderly, assist the elderly in employment, and protect the rights and interests of the elderly in re-employment. Promote the "Silver Age Action," guiding the elderly with certain experience and professional skills to actively participate in civil mediation and other activities in the form of volunteer services. People's courts at all levels may, based on actual conditions, explore the establishment of a database of retired judges, encouraging retired judges who are willing to actively participate in pre-litigation mediation, investigation and research, etc.

12. Lawfully and properly adjudicate cases related to the participation of the elderly in social and cultural life to promote learning and enjoyment for the elderly in old age. Properly adjudicate disputes over tourism contracts involving the elderly, supervise and guide service institutions to fully and reasonably perform their obligations of notification, explanation, and safety assurance, continuously improve the quality of life of the elderly, and meet the growing needs of the elderly for a better life.

13. Increase efforts to crack down on illegal and criminal acts that infringe upon the personal and property rights and interests of the elderly. Lawfully severely punish illegal and criminal acts such as abuse, abandonment, and injury of the elderly. Vigorously crack down on telecommunications and internet fraud targeting the elderly, "routine loans" under the guise of "housing for elderly care," and lawfully punish illegal and criminal acts by family members such as theft, fraud, robbery, embezzlement, extortion, and intentional destruction of the property of the elderly. Lawfully severely punish illegal and criminal acts in the field of consumption, protect the consumer rights and interests of the elderly, and create a safe, convenient, and honest consumption environment for the elderly.

14. Increase enforcement efforts in cases involving the rights and interests of the elderly. People's courts at all levels shall increase enforcement efforts in cases involving the right of habitation of the elderly, lawfully and promptly uphold the right of habitation of the elderly, and ensure that the elderly have a place to live. Increase the intensity of advance enforcement in cases where the elderly claim maintenance or support fees. Innovate enforcement methods for cases involving disputes over spiritual support for the elderly, and supervise and guide those obligated to support the elderly to actively perform their support obligations.

III. Continuously Deepen Reform and Innovation, and Establish and Improve Judicial Service Mechanisms that are Convenient and Beneficial for the Elderly

15. Deepen the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution mechanism to promote the resolution of disputes involving the elderly at the source. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, insist on placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first. Establish and improve early warning, screening, and mediation mechanisms for disputes involving the elderly, such as marriage and family disputes and tort disputes. Build a diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system to promote the one-stop diversified resolution of disputes involving the elderly. Promote the extension of the people's courts' one-stop diversified dispute resolution to the grassroots, advance people's tribunals into villages, communities, and grids, strengthen circuit trials, and promptly resolve disputes locally. Adhere to a demand-oriented service for the elderly, build a one-stop litigation service center, and provide litigation services that are "one-stop for all procedures, one-network for all channels, one-number for all calls, and one-time for all matters."

16. Deeply promote the integration of core socialist values into the reasoning of judgments. In cases involving the protection of vulnerable groups such as the elderly, where there are significant disputes between litigation parties and may cause widespread social concern, strengthen the use of core socialist values in the reasoning of judgments. Strengthen the guiding role of core socialist values in cases involving the rights and interests of the elderly, effectively exert the functions of judicial judgments in norms, evaluation, education, and guidance, and achieve an organic unity of political, legal, and social effects.

17. Further deepen the reform of family trial methods and work mechanisms. Establish a humanized trial philosophy, focusing on extending the protection of elderly parties from identity interests and property interests to personality interests, safety interests, and emotional interests. Fully leverage the diagnostic, restorative, and therapeutic functions of family trials on marital and family relationships, providing a harmonious and stable family environment for the elderly to enjoy a happy old age.

18. Strengthen legal publicity. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen the legal publicity of the protection of the rights and interests of the elderly through various methods such as bringing law into communities, circuit trials, and promoting learning from typical cases. Improve the awareness of the elderly in using legal means to protect their own rights and interests, and enhance their ability to identify and prevent fraud. Promote the establishment of legal awareness in the whole society to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the elderly, forming a good atmosphere of care and concern for the elderly.

19. Strengthen legal aid cooperation and judicial relief efforts. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with legal aid institutions, and promptly transfer the legal aid applications of elderly parties according to law. For elderly parties who meet the conditions for judicial relief, the people's court shall provide relief according to law. Cooperate with relevant departments to increase the assistance of temporary shelter and legal aid for elderly victims, increase judicial relief efforts, and promote the establishment of a multi-level relief system.

20. Establish an age-friendly litigation service mechanism to provide guarantees for facilitating the participation of the elderly in litigation activities. Focus on the types and characteristics of cases involving the elderly, and explore the establishment of a specialized trial mechanism for civil cases involving the elderly. Lawfully allow elderly persons who have genuine difficulty in writing a complaint to make an oral complaint, effectively providing guidance and assistance to the elderly in litigation services. Open green channels such as door-to-door case filing and telephone case filing for the elderly with mobility difficulties to achieve fast and convenient case filing. While carrying out online case filing and electronic litigation, retain traditional judicial service methods that are easily acceptable to the elderly. Improve barrier-free litigation facilities and services to facilitate the participation of the elderly in litigation. Depending on the circumstances of the case, allow relevant auxiliary and accompanying personnel to accompany the elderly party to appear in court. Lawfully and properly handle petitions and complaint cases involving the elderly, and provide special care for elderly parties.

March 29, 2022
